shell.impersonation: Support view: {workspace} — WRITING IS BLOCKED, the view expires at {expires}.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.noAccess: You are not allowed to view the log.
dashboard.unverifiedWarning: You have an unverified domain — ventMail will not send from it.

domains.title: Domains
domains.name: Domain
domains.empty: No domains yet — sending requires a verified domain.
domains.unverified: {count} domain(s) are not verified — ventMail will not send from them.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.channelsHint: Leave empty to allow every channel.
apiKeys.issuedOnce: This key is shown ONCE. Copy it now — afterwards only the prefix remains.

smtp.title: SMTP credentials
smtp.name: Name
smtp.domainHint: Bound to a domain, the credential may only send from it.
smtp.channelHint: A marketing credential cannot send transactional mail — and vice versa.
smtp.issuedOnce: The password is shown ONCE. Copy it now — it cannot be recovered, only reissued.
smtp.relayNote: No open relay: every SMTP submission is authenticated, TLS-only, and passes the same PreSendGate as the API.

suppressions.title: Suppression list
suppressions.note: The suppression list is the PreSendGate's second gate: nothing is sent to an address on it.
suppressions.scopeHint: "marketing" blocks marketing only; "all" blocks transactional too.
suppressions.added: Address added to the suppression list.
suppressions.missing: This address is not on the suppression list.
suppressions.irrevocable: Complaint- and unsubscribe-based suppressions cannot be removed: that is the recipient's will.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.name: Name
webhooks.urlHint: Only a public https address is accepted (SSRF protection).
webhooks.eventsHint: Leave empty to receive every event.
webhooks.secretOnce: The signing secret is shown ONCE. Copy it now.
webhooks.deadLetterWarning: {count} delivery/deliveries went to dead-letter — fix the endpoint, then replay.
webhooks.noEndpoints: No endpoints yet — without one no delivery chain starts.

ipPools.title: IP pools and warmup
ipPools.quarantinedWarning: {count} IP(s) are quarantined — the rest carry more volume, which during warmup costs reputation.
ipPools.warmupNote: {count} IP(s) are warming up: the daily cap grows gradually, and mail above it is DELAYED, not lost.
ipPools.empty: No IP is assigned to this workspace.

deliverability.title: Deliverability
deliverability.listedWarning: {count} blocklist hit(s) — your customers notice this before we do: suddenly nobody receives their mail.
deliverability.dmarcHint: Under `p=none` a failure has no consequence yet — but it shows what would happen under `p=reject`.
deliverability.unverified: {count} domain(s) are unverified — the PreSendGate will not send from them.

validation.title: Address validation
validation.probeNote: The mailbox probe is rate-limited and cached: receivers punish frequent probing, which is why there is no "validate everything" button.

billing.title: Billing
billing.suspendedWarning: The account is SUSPENDED for non-payment — sending stops at the fourth gate. Settling restores it immediately.

audience.title: Audience
audience.name: Name
audience.unconfirmedWarning: {count} contact(s) have no confirmed marketing consent — the third gate will not send marketing to them.

templates.title: Templates
templates.name: Name
templates.subject: Subject
templates.preheaderHint: The short text shown after the subject in the mailbox list.
templates.previewEmpty: Add a block to see the preview.
templates.unsubscribeRequired: A marketing template MUST contain an unsubscribe block — saving is rejected without it.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.name: Name
campaigns.subject: Subject
campaigns.lockedReason: While sending, content and targeting cannot be changed: sending half a campaign elsewhere is worse than waiting.
campaigns.fromHint: Only a verified domain may send — the first gate checks this.
campaigns.localTimeHint: The time is interpreted in the chosen timezone — "09:00" alone means nothing.
